posts.title: Inner Critic/Advocate
posts.description: "There's two wolves, yeah, battle in us all right now One's good, the other one is evil If you're wondering which wolf inside will succeed It's simple, it's the one that you feed" - Falling In Reverse - Chemical Prisoner Which one i feed should be obvious... Life is hard. Struggling with mental health is also difficult. Maybe I learn how to feed the good wolf.
